declared_gaps: LIN physical-layer coverage is currently TJA1021-centric and needs a second independent LIN transceiver family.
J1939 now has generic Microchip evidence plus Hatz C81 OEM semantics, but another independent vehicle/engine implementation is still desirable.
Vision cases currently validate routing only, not visual diagnostic accuracy.
Sensor, schematic and PCB reasoning coverage is still shallow compared with driver/power/network coverage.
Real repair cases remain only CASE-0001 and CASE-0002; more independent workshop cases are required before training acceptance.
